relocation_line: I will relocate to Sydney for this role and can start two weeks after an offer.
cover_letter_text:
Hi Cono Services team,

My name's Marc, and I'd like to apply for your Bulk Excavation & Civil Site Engineer job. I graduated in February 2026 with an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, and I've also got a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019). Your ad pitches it at graduate to intermediate level, and a graduate site role is what I'm looking for.

On site in the Philippines from April 2019 to February 2020, I checked the work against the drawings, did safety checks and quality monitoring, and escalated anything that needed fixing. For the diploma I designed earthworks and lodged Before You Dig Australia enquiries to work around existing services.

I can move to Sydney and start two weeks after an offer. I have full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa), a White Card and a driver's licence. Happy to chat any time.

Kind regards,
Marc Masarate
